seo.title: Jurerê Vacation Apartments, 50 m from the Beach
intro: Two apartments in the same building, each sleeping up to 3. The beach is 50 m away, and parking is free.
properties.title: The two apartments
remote: Both have Wi-Fi and a work desk, so a few weeks of remote work is realistic.
neighborhood.text: We're on the Tradicional side of Jurerê, the quieter residential part.
